Read from a PRS copy (official govtpress PDF 404); file kept at data/raw/MP.EODB2026/MP.EODB2026_bi_prs.pdf, sha256 1536ee677227d5f7f017caf8e9ca8285e9d60a2c0f2ac73c6ccb56b6272fb5e4. No document row.

instruments.title_en: The Madhya Pradesh Land Revenue Code (Amendment) Act, 2018 (No. 23 of 2018)
